detail: Full summary: finding: the plugin subagent-stop hook queues a 'Subagent completed: workflow-subagent' status post per finished workflow agent; the server drains pending-posts.jsonl into the blackboard and exports each to records/posts/ — 7 such records landed in the committed tree from this session's 7-agent verification workflow. Hook-generated status noise rides git to every host.
